It also counts the character composition: CJK characters, Latin letters, U+FFFD replacement characters and control characters.

map.因为短文本信息量不足：GBK 与 Big5 的字节区间大面积重叠，纯 ASCII: Because short text carries insufficient information: the byte ranges of GBK and Big5 overlap extensively, pure ASCII content is valid under almost all encodings, and UTF-8 and Latin-1 have no BOM to distinguish them.
